q: Kill Garrick Padfoot and bring his head to Deputy Willem at Northshire Abbey.
Bring Ran Bloodtooth's Skull and Dartol's Rod of Transformation to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.
This Is Going to Be Hard
Defeat the Fam'retor Guardian and bring Lotwil's Shackles of Elemental Binding back to Lotwil Veriatus.
Kill Balgaras the Foul and bring his ear to Longbraid the Grim outside of Dun Modr.
Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, then return any information you find to Executor Arren.
Find the Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent.
Kill Maggot Eye and return to Executor Zygand in Brill with his paw for a reward.
High Executor Darthalia of Tarren Mill is offering a bounty on Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, Citizen Wilkes, Miner Hackett and Farmer Kalaba.
Bring 7 Jungle Remedies and 1 Venom Fern Extract to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
Doctor Draxlegauge in Faldir's Cove wants you to collect 10 Elven Gems and return the Goggles of Gem Hunting once you are done.
Gather 6 discolored worg hearts and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 10 Mountain Cougar Pelts.
Kill 12 Dustwind Savages and 8 Dustwind Storm Witches for Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
Bring 4 Carved Stone Urns to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.
Bring Calor's note to Jonathan Carevin.
Bring Lok's Skull to Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
Bring the Rendered Spores to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff, before the time limit is up.
Bring 12 Red Burlap Bandanas to Deputy Willem outside the Northshire Abbey.
Destroy the Ancient Moonstone Seal at the ancient flame in Ameth'Aran, then return to Asterion in Bashal'Aran.
Kill Geltharis and return the Branch of Cenarius to Illiyana at Forest Song.
Bring the Nether Gem to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
Novice Elreth requires 6 Scavenger Paws and 6 Duskbat Wings.
Slay the gnoll Hogger and bring his Huge Gnoll Claw to Marshal Dughan.
Speak to Telf Joolam for another Fire Sapta.
Bring 1 Fire Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Telf Joolam in Durotar.
Speak with Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
Bring 15 Centaur Ears to Felgur Twocuts in Desolace.
Speak to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
Escort Galen out of danger, then find his camp in the Swamp of Sorrows and open his strongbox.
Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete your robe and then speak to her again.
Bring two Solid Iron Mauls, two Silvered Bronze Boots, and two Silvered Bronze Gauntlets to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.
Bring three Scorpok Pincers, two Vulture Gizzards, and one Blasted Boar Lung to Bloodmage Drazial.
Bring three Scorpok Pincers, two Vulture Gizzards, and one Blasted Boar Lung to Bloodmage Drazial.
Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Spigot Operator Luglunket in Gadgetzan.
Bring the Brilliant Gold Ring, a Silver Bar, a Moss Agate, and 30 silver coins to Nogg in Orgrimmar.
Bring Stoley's Bottle to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.
Orwin Gizzmick in Camp Mojache wants 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.
Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.
Slay Lathoric the Black and Obsidion, and return to Thorius in Ironforge with the Head of Lathoric the Black and the Heart of Obsidion.
The Atal'ai Exile in The Hinterlands wants the Head of Jammal'an.
Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Amethyst, Opal, and Diamond and obtain the Runestones.
Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst and obtain the Runestones.
Ogre Head On A Stick = Party
Take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head and place it at the top of Dreadmaul Rock. Look for a soft dirt mound to plant the pike.
Collect 8 Webbed Diemetradon Scales and 8 Webbed Pterrordax Scales for Shizzle in Marshal's Refuge.
Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.
Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.

In order to create the Leggings of Arcana, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Frostwhisper's Embalming Fluid.
Retrieve Noggle's Satchel from the mountains in the south of Silithus and return it to him at Cenarion Hold.
Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.
Fill the Empty Cleansing Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell.
Report back what you have found to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
Speak to Thrall in Orgrimmar and tell him what you've learned.
Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.
Find 10 pieces of Soft-shelled Clam Meat and bring it back to Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village.
Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.
Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.
Find Rackmore's Silver Key. Find Rackmore's Golden Key. Find and open Rackmore's Chest.
Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.
Retrieve the Compendium of the Fallen from the Monastery in Tirisfal Glades and return to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.
Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh in Theramore on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh.

You must get Onyxia to breathe fire on the Unfired Ancient Blade. Once this is done, pick up the now Heated Ancient Blade. Be warned, a Heated Ancient Blade will not remain heated forever - time is of the essence.
Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!
Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!
Return the book to its rightful owners.
Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.
Bring me thise things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.
Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Bracers
Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Armsplint. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Bring the voodoo feathers to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.

Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to find his beloved Natalia. The information that you gathered points to Hive'Regal in the south as being the area in which you may find Mistress Natalia Mar'alith.

Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 Powerful Anti-Venom and 4 Smoked Desert Dumplings to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.

Report for duty at the Ironforge Brigade post near Hive'Zora. Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers and obtain Signed Field Duty Papers from Captain Blackanvil and return to Windcaller Kaldon at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Bring 3 Ornate Mithril Boots to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.

Bring 10 Dense Grinding Stones, 10 Solid Grinding Stones and 10 Heavy Grinding Stones to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

Bring 1 Mooncloth, 2 Bolts of Runecloth and 1 Ironweb Spider Silk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VIII in order to complete this quest.
Bring 2 Enchanted Thorium Bars and 2 Enchanted Leather to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.

Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 20 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Cenarius to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

Bring Vek'nilash's Circlet, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
Bring Vek'lor's Diadem, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Vermillion Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Summon Omen, defeat him and gain Elune's Blessing. Return to Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven
Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bracers of Valor to Deliana in Ironforge.
Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bracers of Valor to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Magister's Boots, Magister's Leggings and Magister's Mantle.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Magister's Boots, Magister's Leggings and Magister's Mantle.
Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Lightforge Boots, Lightforge Legplates and Lightforge Spaulders.
Dirk Thunderwood at Cenarion Hold wants you to bring him Venoxis's Venom Sac and Kurinnaxx's Venom Sac.

Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Redemption Headpiece if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Headpiece, 15 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 5 Arcanite Bars and 2 Cured Rugged Hides.

Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Bonescythe Breastplate if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Breastplate, 25 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 2 Arcanite Bars and 6 Cured Rugged Hides.

Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Frostfire Sandals if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Sandals, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.
